name: Blooming Arch : Leafling
source:
Do you remember the classic Leafling tales for the Arch Ceremony?

Play as a Leafling to learn new songs and visit new places to become the honorary singer at the Ceremony! With the revival of the ceremony and all types of Leaflings joining this year, experience the competition to win!

[From [url=https://cedesdc.itch.io/blooming-arch-leafling-demo]itch.io[/url]]
